w: Samarpan Din On Swamishri's last full day in Houston, the Southwest Region held Samarpan Din, where they recognised the sacrifices of countless devotees in organising and executing the Mandir Mahotsav. After Swamishri's morning puja, a special mahapuja was held for all devotees to bring peace into their lives and to fulfil their inner wishes. During the evening assembly, Swamishri explained that the most important thing to do after the construction of the Mandir is to take full advantage of it, and increase our understanding of our soul. "Once one has knowledge of the soul," he said, "one will not desire to indulge in the pleasures of the world."

With the heavy monsoon rains many villages in Kheda district were flooded and left people marooned. On Swamishri’s instruction BAPS sadhus and volunteers provided rescue and relief. Food packets and relief materials prepared in Bochasan and Atladra mandirs were supplied by volunteers to the flood-affected victims.

At 4.00 pm Swamishri arrived for an assembly on the occasion of the solar eclipse. The assembly commenced with the Swaminarayan dhun followed by a discourse by Viveksagar Swami, bhajans by sadhus and a question-answer session with senior sadhus. The assembly concluded at 6.05 pm.
